derivation: of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood;
def: corresponding to H02506 and H01818); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem

occurrences.text: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
